home.subtitle: Every prediction comes from a Poisson statistical model built on form, goals for/against, and home advantage — not opinion or fan bias.

home.engineBody: A single Poisson probability matrix feeds every market — 1X2, Double Chance, Asian Handicap, HT/FT, Over/Under, BTTS, Correct Score, Scorer. Corners/Cards use a separate model (they don't come from goals).
